retrieval_policy.artifact_provenance: Course-manager inventory derived from the supplied CSDIY catalog snapshot; URL contents were not fetched.
rules: Begin only from a URL recorded in the catalog snapshot or from a verified public page reached from such a URL.
Do not authenticate, bypass access controls, scrape restricted content, or seek unofficial mirrors.
Treat a URL as a locator, never as evidence that its content is available or that it is an official unit.
Record requested URL, final URL, access outcome, content digest, source commit when applicable, and a license/use decision.
Keep source repositories read-only and copy only authorized inputs into per-attempt workspaces.
Default to linking rather than copying when reuse rights are unclear.
Classify each retrieved object as official unit, supporting resource, catalog/index page, or blocked before graph admission.
Never expose secrets, sealed references, private tests, examiner materials, or another learner's files.
Failed or unavailable retrieval remains a durable blocked record and must not be silently converted into an available material.
retrieval_policy.graph_expansion_gate: Only a separate validated job may turn a verified official item into a new unit node.
retrieval_policy.fallback_for_this_unit: Use the local manager-authored learner bundle; no external material is required.
